landmarks.name: Sundarbans
landmarks.writeup: The largest mangrove forest in the world, home to the Bengal tiger and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

landmarks.name: Lalbagh Fort
landmarks.writeup: A 17th-century Mughal fort complex in Dhaka, known for its beautiful architecture and historical significance.

landmarks.name: Ahsan Manzil
landmarks.writeup: The Pink Palace in Dhaka, once the official residential palace of the Nawab of Dhaka.

landmarks.name: Jatiyo Sangsad Bhaban
landmarks.writeup: The National Parliament House, an architectural masterpiece designed by Louis Kahn.

landmarks.name: Cox's Bazar
landmarks.writeup: The world's longest natural sea beach, a popular tourist destination.

cultural_events.name: Pohela Boishakh
cultural_events.writeup: Bengali New Year celebrated with colorful processions, traditional music, and fairs.

cultural_events.name: Eid-ul-Fitr
cultural_events.writeup: A major Islamic festival marking the end of Ramadan, celebrated with prayers, feasts, and charity.

cultural_events.name: Durga Puja
cultural_events.writeup: A Hindu festival honoring the goddess Durga, featuring elaborate rituals and cultural programs.

cultural_events.name: Bishwa Ijtema
cultural_events.writeup: One of the largest Islamic congregations in the world, held annually near Dhaka.

food_writeup: Bangladeshi cuisine is rich in flavors, featuring rice and fish as staples. Popular dishes include Hilsa fish curry, Bhuna Khichuri, and sweets like Rasgulla and Sandesh.
brief_history: Bangladesh emerged as an independent country in 1971 after the Liberation War against Pakistan. It has a rich cultural heritage influenced by ancient Bengal, Mughal rule, and British colonialism.

important_people.name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
important_people.description: Founding leader and first President of Bangladesh

important_people.name: Kazi Nazrul Islam
important_people.description: National poet known for his revolutionary works

important_people.name: Rabindranath Tagore
important_people.description: Nobel laureate poet and cultural icon

important_people.name: Muhammad Yunus
important_people.description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate and pioneer of microfinance

current_conflicts: Bangladesh faces challenges related to political tensions, border disputes with Myanmar, and issues surrounding the Rohingya refugee crisis.
